title: Make the Origami Master Prompt the portable baseline and development tools optional

before.state: Origami owned its own canonical profile and perceptual reveal semantics, but active documentation and integration contracts still over-emphasized Tlaloc/Hybrid tooling and did not make prompt-only no-sandbox/no-tool compatibility a first-class boundary.

after.state: Origami explicitly owns its semantics, Master Prompt, visual profile and releases. Tlaloc, Blueprint Framework and future systems are optional development tools; Tonal is optional composition. Master Prompt R2 is the portable compatibility baseline and assumes no tools/sandbox/runtime unless explicitly provided.
